page.content:
Experimental Tyrell replicant who believes she is human.

How Rachael connects

  • Work: Blade Runner (1982) — Rachael's test and flight are central to 1982.
  • Faction: Tyrell Corporation — Rachael is Tyrell's experimental replicant.
  • Creator: Ana Stelline — Ana is Rachael's daughter.
  • Character: Rick Deckard — Deckard leaves the city with Rachael.

What is Rachael?

Rachael is Tyrell's niece-that-isn't, a replicant given implanted memories who fails the Voight-Kampff slowly and leaves the city with Deckard.

Key threads lead to Blade Runner (1982), Tyrell Corporation, Ana Stelline and Rick Deckard.
